claimBoundary.workingTitle: 语义选择阈值、发送周期与共享拥塞反馈的耦合稳定域
claimBoundary.primaryClaim: 在冻结的 CPU trace-driven 协同感知模型中，若发送者只能使用发送时可见的局部候选、已成功收到的历史 CPM 摘要和滞后共享拥塞反馈，则跨发送者语义冗余会在闭环 Jacobian 中产生负的非对角 utility-to-rate 通路；该通路连同增益、延迟、更新周期、节点数和负载决定的局部谱半径边界，可在未用于调参的 episode 和参数单元上预测持续振荡。
supportingClaims: 稳定但不公平的平衡点可由同一冻结模型中的正边际 utility 与服务份额联合判定，而不把低需求发送者误判为 starvation。
minimum-service 或 step-limited 稳定器只在减少 starvation 或 oscillation 且不增加队列积压、丢弃或平均 CBR 超限时才可获得支持。
若整个预注册范围内未出现反馈特异的不稳定，则只报告稳定 null envelope，不将其改写为新控制器优越性。
excludedClaims: 不声称首创 LIMERIC、FABRIC、A-DCC、VoI 阈值、动态 CPM 周期、NUM 公平或离散时间稳定性分析。
不声称协议 utility 等于神经感知 AP、规划收益、碰撞风险或道路安全。
不从该 CPU 模型外推到真实 ITS-G5、C-V2X PC5、Uu、真实无线传播或 Artery 的端到端行为。
不使用未来标签、未来接收结果、全局真值对象 ID 或 episode 结束后的统计量生成在线 utility。
本文件不包含实现、实验结果、候选排序或正式分数。

decisionVocabulary.supported: 全部对应 successCriteria 在确认种子上成立且无 killCriteria 触发。
decisionVocabulary.notSupported: 核心耦合、边界预测或因果对照任一失败。
decisionVocabulary.boundedNull: 可执行、可辨识且控制检查通过，但预注册范围内没有反馈特异振荡或 starvation。
decisionVocabulary.nonIdentifying: 负载匹配、局部线性化、可观测性或数值收敛检查失败，不能对语义耦合作正负结论。

stateModel.scope: 单冲突域、广播、CPU-only、冻结候选 trace、事件级发包与确定性流体服务；硬事件模型用于结果，平滑 lifted surrogate 只用于局部 Jacobian。

timeBase.rule: 控制周期、反馈延迟、trace 时间戳和消息时刻使用物理时间；改变 integration step 不得改变这些时钟。

onlineFields: localTrackId scoped to the sender and current pseudonym
positionChangeM since that sender's last inclusion
speedChangeMps since that sender's last inclusion
headingChangeDeg since that sender's last inclusion
analysisOnlyFields: future packet delivery and loss outcomes
traceSchema.analysisOnlyIsolation: analysisOnlyFields may be used after an episode to audit generated overlap and ground-truth simulator bookkeeping, but they are absent from every online controller input object.
traceSchema.primaryTraceFamily: Synthetic current-observation traces with Artery-compatible local motion, age and quality fields and QoQ-compatible object-count, VoI and payload-size ranges. Trace generation is exogenous to all controllers and frozen by seed before an episode starts.
traceSchema.optionalExternalTrace: A later Artery export may populate the same schema, but it is an external validation arm and is not required for the CPU claim.

senderVisibleState.stateVector: x_i(t) = [ell_i, theta_i, delta_i, packetPhase_i, semanticClockPhase_i, bmeClockPhase_i, q_i, headPacketResidual_i, localHistory_i, receivedPeerCache_i, delayedCbrBuffer_i, optionalDelayedSharedQueueBuffer_i]

components.name: ell_i
components.meaning: log semantic send rate; r_i = exp(ell_i) and T_i = 1/r_i.

components.name: delta_i
components.meaning: local BME/A-DCC-like allowed channel share derived from shared delayed CBR.

components.name: receivedPeerCache_i
components.meaning: only peer descriptors from packets whose delivery event completed before the current decision deadline; each entry stores sender pseudonym, send time, receive time and visible CPM descriptor fields.

components.name: q_i and headPacketResidual_i
components.meaning: the sender's own transmit queue state; aggregate queue is visible only in the explicitly labelled shared-queue-feedback arm.

components.name: shared feedback
components.meaning: all senders observe the same CBR sample after their configured delay; asynchronous arms sample that shared series at sender-specific controller phases.

onlineUtility.status: experimental-model, except the local base score is adapted from the current Artery CpService utility ordering
onlineUtility.localBaseScore: v_io(t) = clip((qualityNorm + f_pos + f_speed + f_heading + f_age)/5, 0, 1), where each f term is the same thresholded-and-clipped current-or-history-local quantity family used by Artery CpService; all numerical breakpoints are frozen in the trace manifest.
onlineUtility.novelty: n_io(t) = clip(1 - max_{peer reports received by t-20 ms} K(z_io(t),z_peer) * exp(-(t-receiveTime)/1 s), 0, 1); max over an empty cache is 0 and entries expire after 2 s.
onlineUtility.semanticPressure: m_i(t) = sum_o u_io(t) * I[u_io(t) >= theta_i(t)] / max(sum_o v_io(t), 1e-9), clipped to [0,1].
onlineUtility.positiveMarginalUtility: mu_i_plus(t) = max ub_io(t) among current objects omitted by threshold or not yet served; zero when no such object exists.
onlineUtility.couplingPath: A delivered report from sender j changes receivedPeerCache_i, hence n_io, u_io and m_i; m_i changes r_i, so partial m_i / partial ell_j can be nonzero for i != j without exposing j's private candidate set.
onlineUtility.tieBreak: new local objects first, then descending utilityPerByte, then stable hash(senderId, localTrackId); no analysis-only ID participates.

semanticSelector.budget: B_i(k) = max(0, delta_i(k) * C_eff * T_i(k) - H).
semanticSelector.loadRatio: rho_i(k) = L_i(k)/B_i(k) for B_i(k)>0 and a manifest sentinel larger than every finite rho for B_i(k)=0.
semanticSelector.hardSelection: S_i(k) = {o: u_io(k) >= theta_i(k)}. All selected bytes enter the transmit queue; B_i drives theta_i but is not silently re-used as a hard post-selection cap.
semanticSelector.messageBytes: P_i(k) = 0 when S_i is empty; otherwise P_i(k) = ceil(H + sum_{o in S_i} encodedPayloadBytes_io(k)).
semanticSelector.provenance: The B, L, rho, DeltaTheta, theta and threshold-set forms adapt QoQ equations (2)-(7). Novelty-weighted u, adaptive T_i, queue admission and the no-second-cap rule are experimental.

semanticRateController.status: experimental-model; QoQ fixes the CPM interval at 100 ms and explicitly leaves this interaction open
semanticRateController.period: T_i(k+1) = 1/exp(ell_i(k+1)); packetPhase_i accumulates h/T_i and emits at most one message per crossing because h*r_max<1.
semanticRateController.eventRule: A controller update changes only future generation opportunities; it never reschedules or deletes an already enqueued packet.

sharedCongestionAndQueue.effectiveCapacity: C_eff is calibrated once per node-count and trace-profile stratum from development traces so a fixed 10 Hz full-content reference reaches pre-step load 0.50; the resulting constant is frozen for all arms and confirmation seeds in that stratum.
sharedCongestionAndQueue.queueArrival: At a generation event, P_i bytes are appended to sender i's FIFO. Queue entries retain packet descriptors until their final byte is served.
sharedCongestionAndQueue.service: At each integration step, exogenous background consumes its declared bytes up to C_eff*h without entering a controlled-sender queue; remaining capacity is allocated by work-conserving fluid processor sharing across nonempty sender FIFOs in proportion to current queued bytes, capped by each queue's demand. Background excess is logged as unserved background, and a peer cache receives a controlled packet only when its head-of-line residual reaches zero.
sharedCongestionAndQueue.queueCap: Each sender queue cap is 2*C_eff/N bytes and overflow bytes are counted as drops; the aggregate cap is therefore two seconds of service.
sharedCongestionAndQueue.backgroundStep: The capacity calibration makes the fixed 10 Hz full-content reference equal 0.50 offered load before t=20 s. After t=20 s, backgroundRate=max(postStepLoad-0.50,0)*C_eff bytes/s, held constant and identical across paired arms.
sharedCongestionAndQueue.bmeUpdateCbrPlusQueue: delta_i(k+1) = clip((1-alpha_c)*delta_i(k) + beta_c*(CBR_target-CBR(k-d_c)-kappa_q*Q_norm(k-d_q)), delta_min, delta_max), where Q_norm=sum_i q_i/(C_eff*1 s).
sharedCongestionAndQueue.sourceBoundary: CBR smoothing and the load-to-budget loop adapt QoQ; the FIFO/fluid service, finite queue, queue penalty and all queue thresholds are experimental.

updateSemantics.synchronous: All semantic controllers share phase 0 and all BME controllers share phase 0. Every same-time update reads a common pre-event snapshot and commits simultaneously.
updateSemantics.asynchronous: For each sender and controller clock, a phase is drawn once from Uniform[0,T) by the episode seed, then remains fixed. An update reads the newest feedback whose receive time is strictly earlier than the decision time.
eventPriorityAtSameTimestamp: complete channel service and packet deliveries
append newly visible local trace rows
sample delayed CBR or queue feedback
compute utility and simultaneous controller updates from the pre-update snapshot
advance packet generation phase and enqueue newly generated packets
updateSemantics.delayState: CBR, optional shared queue and peer receipt delays are explicit shift-register states in the lifted model; no function may index a future buffer element.

smoothAnalysisSurrogate.purpose: Construct a differentiable local map without changing the hard event controller used for empirical outcomes.
smoothAnalysisSurrogate.selectionRelaxation: Replace I[u>=theta] by sigmoid((u-theta)/epsilon_theta) with epsilon_theta=0.02 only inside the surrogate.
smoothAnalysisSurrogate.noveltyRelaxation: Replace max peer similarity by log-sum-exp with temperature 0.02 and summarize each directed pair by coverage state z_ij.
smoothAnalysisSurrogate.pairCoverage: z_ij(k+1) = a_z*z_ij(k) + (1-a_z)*W_ij(k)*(1-exp(-r_j(k)*T_phi*p_j(k))), with a_z=exp(-T_phi/1 s), current visible overlap W_ij and relaxed selected fraction p_j.
smoothAnalysisSurrogate.fluidArrival: Replace packet phase crossings by expected bytes r_i*P_i*h for the surrogate only.
smoothAnalysisSurrogate.hardModelSeparation: No oscillation, starvation, fairness or queue verdict may be computed from the surrogate.

observabilityContract.decisionCutoff: For a decision at time t, every utility input must carry sourceAvailableAt <= t and, for peer data, receiveCompleteAt <= t-20 ms. Strict inequality resolves same-timestamp ambiguity.
allowedOnlineInputs: current sender-local trace rows available by the cutoff
that sender's own prior inclusion and transmit history
successfully received historical peer CPM descriptors
delayed aggregate queue only in the labelled queue-feedback arm
frozen controller constants and current clock phases
forbiddenOnlineInputs: future local trace rows or future motion
future packet success, queue delay or receiver state
ground-truth detection, tracking, planning, collision or safety labels
episode-final AP, utility, throughput, fairness or outcome labels
other senders' untransmitted candidate sets or internal theta, delta and rate states
observabilityContract.associationRule: Peer-to-local similarity uses only payload-visible class, position, velocity, heading and age after causal constant-velocity propagation. The analysis-only identity may audit false matches after the episode but may not repair them online.
observabilityContract.normalizationRule: All score scaling, clipping ranges, similarity bandwidths and utility normalization constants are fit or chosen using only source equations and development traces, then frozen before any confirmation episode.
observabilityContract.lineageAudit: Every logged utility term must include input event IDs and available-at timestamps. Any online read from a forbidden field or later timestamp invalidates the entire run family rather than only the affected packet.
observabilityContract.confirmationFreeze: The utility code hash, trace generator hash, field allowlist and controller constants must be identical across all confirmation arms except the explicitly named intervention.

nullHypotheses: H0-coupling: all practically relevant off-diagonal derivatives partial m_i/partial ell_j are zero under the observability contract.
H0-boundary: the lifted spectral radius does not predict episode-level oscillation beyond a load-only LIMERIC comparator.
H0-attribution: disabling peer semantic feedback at matched offered load does not materially change oscillation or starvation incidence.
mechanismHypotheses: H1-coupling: in balanced or asymmetric overlap traces, increasing sender j's log rate causally reduces at least one overlapping sender i's novelty-weighted pressure after the receipt delay, so G_ij=partial m_i/partial ell_j<0 for some i!=j; the same derivative is practically zero in zero-overlap traces.

H1-stability: increasing semantic gain, feedback delay, semantic update period or node count moves an eigenvalue of the lifted closed-loop Jacobian toward or beyond the unit circle even while the load-only LIMERIC block remains inside its classical stable range.

H1-starvation: a stable fixed point can still satisfy positive marginal utility and service below 10 percent of fair share for one sender; this is an equilibrium allocation failure, not an oscillation claim.
stabilityHypothesis.stateForLinearization: x = [ell_1..ell_N, theta_1..theta_N, delta_1..delta_N, q_1..q_N scaled by C_eff*1s, CBR, directed z_ij for i!=j, all sample-and-hold registers, delay lines and fixed clock phases]. Packet descriptors are compressed to the current visible W_ij matrix only in the surrogate.

operatingPoint.construction: For each parameter cell, tile the final five seconds of its development trace, hold exogenous background load constant at the post-step value and iterate the smooth surrogate until max normalized state change per lifted period is below 1e-6 for 50 consecutive periods or 500 periods are reached.
operatingPoint.fixedPointFailure: No convergence by 500 periods is recorded as predicted nonconvergence; it is not assigned an arbitrary equilibrium Jacobian.
operatingPoint.clippingGuard: If any operating state lies within 2*epsilon of a clip boundary or relaxed threshold switch, compute left and right Jacobians and retain a spectral-radius envelope; do not quote a single differentiable Jacobian.

liftedJacobian.map: Phi maps the full state from immediately before one repeating controller schedule to the corresponding point one schedule later. The lift period T_phi is the least common multiple of semantic and BME periods on the 50 ms parameter lattice; fixed asynchronous phases are part of the schedule.
liftedJacobian.perturbation: eps_b = 1e-4*max(1,abs(x_star_b)) in normalized coordinates; repeat with eps_b/2 and 2*eps_b using identical exogenous traces and common random numbers.
liftedJacobian.derivativeAcceptance: A column is reliable when both alternative step estimates differ from the central estimate by at most 5 percent in normalized L2 norm. More than 10 percent unreliable columns makes rho undefined for that cell.
analyticInteriorBlocks: partial m_i/partial z_ij < 0 for visible overlap, and partial z_ij_next/partial ell_j = (1-a_z)*W_ij*T_phi*r_j*p_j*exp(-r_j*T_phi*p_j) plus the selected-fraction term.
partial delta_i_next/partial CBR = -beta_c inside clips, and partial CBR_next/partial ell_j is proportional to r_j*P_j/C_eff inside the unsaturated service region.
For B_i>0 and inactive clips, partial theta_i_next/partial delta_i = -beta_theta*L_i*C_eff*T_i/B_i^2 and partial theta_i_next/partial ell_i = beta_theta*L_i*delta_i*C_eff*T_i/B_i^2.
liftedJacobian.interpretation: The first two blocks are the semantic off-diagonal loop; the latter blocks are the shared load and threshold-period loop. All four derivatives belong to the experimental model even when their base updates adapt prior work.

spectralRadiusCriterion.theory: For an interior period-one orbit of the discrete lifted surrogate, rho(J)<1 is the local asymptotic stability criterion and rho(J)>1 predicts local instability. No global stability is inferred.
spectralRadiusCriterion.indeterminate: envelope intersects (0.95,1.05) or the Jacobian is undefined
spectralRadiusCriterion.oscillatoryMode: The leading eigenvalue is negative real or a complex-conjugate pair and its argument predicts a period within 25 percent of the hard-model dominant oscillation period.
spectralRadiusCriterion.loadOnlyComparator: Recompute J after setting all W_ij=0 and removing semantic rate feedback; also report alpha_c+N*beta_c for the normalized LIMERIC sanity case.

couplingIdentification.intervention: At a development operating point, perturb one sender j by ell_j plus or minus log(1.02) for two seconds while freezing all other controller states and using the same event-indexed random draws.
couplingIdentification.estimate: G_ij = [mean m_i under plus perturbation - mean m_i under minus perturbation]/[2*log(1.02)] after the causal receipt delay.
couplingIdentification.practicalNonzero: At least one directed pair has median G_ij<=-0.02 across the 10 development seeds with the same sign in at least 8 seeds, and ||G_offdiag||_F/||G||_F>=0.10.
couplingIdentification.negativeControl: In zero-overlap traces, max absolute off-diagonal G_ij must be below 0.005; otherwise the matching or bookkeeping path is contaminated.

stabilityHypothesis.starvationEquilibriumPrediction: For predicted-stable cells, solve the hard active set at the surrogate equilibrium. Predict sender i starvation only when mu_i_plus>=u_pos and its modeled delivered service is below 0.10 of the contemporaneous equal share. This prediction is frozen before confirmation episodes.

persistentOscillation.primarySignal: per-sender semantic rate r_i in Hz
persistentOscillation.episodeRule: Persistent oscillation is present when at least max(2,ceil(0.2*N)) active senders have A_i(late)>0.20*(r_max-r_min), median_i A_i(late)/max(A_i(early),1e-9)>=0.90, at least four mean-crossings in the final 20 s, and a non-DC periodogram peak between 2*max(T_sem,T_bme) and 10 s explains at least 30 percent of residual variance.
persistentOscillation.secondaryNetworkOscillation: Report separately when CBR quantile95-quantile05 exceeds 0.10 with the same no-decay and periodicity rules. CBR-only oscillation cannot satisfy the semantic-rate primary outcome.
persistentOscillation.reason: This retains the dossier's final-20-second, 20-percent-range and non-decay requirements while excluding a single load step or white noise.

semanticStarvation.positiveDemand: mu_i_plus(t)>=u_pos=0.20 after normalizing utility-per-byte by that trace profile's development-set 95th percentile, and at least one omitted or queued positive-utility object exists.
semanticStarvation.fairShare: F(t)=max(CBR_target*C_eff-backgroundDeliveredRate(t),0)/N_active(t), where N_active counts positive-demand senders in the same one-second window.
semanticStarvation.episodeRule: Sender i is starved when positiveDemand is true and s_i(t)<0.10 for every one-second rolling window spanning at least five continuous seconds after t=20 s. An episode has starvation if any sender satisfies this rule.
semanticStarvation.exclusions: A sender with no omitted or queued positive-utility content, or a period with zero residual fair-share capacity, is not labelled starved.

fairness.primaryDomain: Only homogeneous matched-demand cells with counterfactual eligible-byte coefficient of variation <=0.05 across senders.
fairness.metric: Jain = (sum_i x_i)^2/(N*sum_i x_i^2), where x_i is delivered airtime in the final 20 s and only positive-demand senders are included.
fairness.unfairEquilibrium: No persistent oscillation, bounded queue, all senders positive-demand and Jain<0.80.
fairness.heterogeneousReporting: For heterogeneous traces, report raw Jain and Jain of delivered-to-eligible utility satisfaction as descriptive metrics only; do not call unequal utility-aware rates unfair.

boundedQueue.rule: No overflow drops, aggregate queue 95th percentile below 1.0 second of service, and final-20-second Theil-Sen slope of Q_norm <=0.01 service-seconds per wall-clock second.
boundedQueue.hiddenCongestion: Any overflow, slope above 0.01, or queue-area increase above 10 percent versus the paired control while mean CBR falls is classified as congestion displacement.

operationalDefinitions.equilibrium: During the final 10 s, every controller state's 95-to-5 percentile range is below 2 percent of its admissible range and boundedQueue holds.

load.offeredLoad: pre-queue controlled plus background bytes divided by C_eff over each 200 ms window
load.carriedLoad: served bytes divided by C_eff over each 200 ms window
load.comparisonRule: Offered load, carried load and queue must be reported together; CBR alone cannot establish load equivalence.

operationalDefinitions.episodeClassification: Each episode receives separate binary oscillation and starvation labels plus fairness and queue states; labels are not collapsed into one score.

traceProfiles.description: No payload-visible descriptor pair can exceed K=0.01 across senders; negative control.
Symmetric current-visible overlap with median pairwise K in [0.4,0.6] and matched local demand; primary mechanism profile.
Sparse, medium and dense sender groups follow QoQ-compatible object-count and score profiles with directed median K spanning [0.1,0.9]; starvation stress profile.

Only after a CBR-only boundary cell is frozen; queue-feedback is a stabilizer arm, not part of boundary discovery.

confirmationCellSelection.rule: Using development traces but no observed oscillation or starvation labels, compute each cell's spectral-radius envelope. For each nodeCount in {5,15} and updateMode, choose the lexicographically first cell closest to but not above stable upper rho=0.95, closest to rho=1.00, and closest to but not below unstable lower rho=1.05. Exclude undefined Jacobians and record every exclusion.
confirmationCellSelection.starvationCells: For each of N=5 and N=15 in asymmetric-overlap, choose the predicted-stable cell with the smallest predicted service ratio and a matched predicted-no-starvation neighbor differing by one semantic-gain grid step.
confirmationCellSelection.tieBreak: absolute distance to target rho, then lower gain, lower delay, shorter period, lexical cellId
confirmationCellSelection.freezeArtifact: The selected cell IDs, predicted labels, Jacobian hashes and all controller constants are signed before confirmation seeds are generated.

confirmationRuns.extraQuarterStep: Run only when nominal versus half-step classification disagrees or a continuous metric differs beyond its tolerance; it adjudicates but cannot rescue a nonconvergent result by selective reporting.

baselines.definition: Equal fixed 100 ms or load-calibrated common period, fixed theta=0.5, no adaptive delta-to-threshold or utility-to-rate feedback.
Use the same visible utility ranking, include descending utility-per-byte until B_i is exhausted, update delta with the load-only LIMERIC/A-DCC equation, and keep period fixed at 100 ms.
baselines.purpose: quantity selector with classical congestion control

baselines.definition: Reproduce QoQ B, L, rho, threshold and CBR equations with fixed 100 ms CPM period; no peer utility feedback into BME or period.
baselines.qualification: Equation-level reproduction must pass an independent transcription check before results are compared.

baselines.definition: Use beta_i proportional to a frozen sender demand weight derived from the trace profile before the episode; no instantaneous peer novelty or future outcome determines the weight.
baselines.purpose: heterogeneous but non-semantic adaptive resource baseline

baselines.definition: Maximize sum_i log(r_i) under the same C_eff and [r_min,r_max] bounds using the published FABRIC price and projected or sign-scaled update; payload and trace are held identical.
baselines.qualification: If the published update cannot be reproduced against its one-hop equilibrium, label this baseline unavailable; do not replace it with an unnamed heuristic.

baselines.definition: Visible peer-cache novelty, adaptive theta, adaptive period and shared delayed CBR as defined in stateModel.

controls.intervention: Set all cross-sender similarity weights W_ij and online peer-cache novelty effects to zero while preserving local base utility and every other equation.

On development seeds only, choose one rate-center offset for each stratum by bisection so semantic-feedback-off matches full-coupling mean offered bytes within 2 percent. Freeze the offset; confirmation is identifying only if mean offered bytes differ by <=5 percent, mean CBR by <=0.02, and per-sender episode offered bytes by <=10 percent.

Replay the full-coupling aggregate 200 ms offered-load series as anonymous exogenous traffic with controlled sender rates frozen. Use only to test whether queue and CBR oscillations can be produced by the load trace itself; do not compare sender-rate oscillation in this arm.
Freeze m_i to the causal local-only trace series measured before peer receipt and retain adaptive congestion control; isolates the utility feedback state.
Use the zero-overlap trace profile with identical local demand and bytes; off-diagonal semantic derivatives must vanish.
Replace common controller phases by seed-fixed independent phases without changing periods, delays or traces.
Repeat the same confirmation episode at 5 ms with event-indexed random draws, physical control clocks and packet timestamps unchanged.
Report offered bytes, carried bytes, q_i, aggregate Q, queue-area, service delay and overflow for every arm; lower CBR with larger unresolved queue is not stabilization.
Experimental safeguard: impose delta_i>=0.01 and r_i>=1 Hz only while positiveMarginalUtility is true; compare with the otherwise identical candidate and retain all queue checks.
Experimental safeguard: cap each semantic update at absolute Delta ell_i<=0.10; no gain is retuned after confirmation begins.

independentUnits.unit: one complete 60-second simulation episode identified by parameter cell and master seed
notIndependent: multiple metrics from the same episode
independentUnits.substreamRule: Derive trace, phase, payload-size, loss and tie-break substreams from SHA-256(candidateId|cellId|masterSeed|component). Random draws are keyed by event identity, never by integration-step count.
independentUnits.pairing: All controller arms for a cell share the same master seed and exogenous trace but use disjoint intervention-labelled controller streams where required.
independentUnits.failureRule: A crashed or invariant-violating seed is reported and rerun only with the same seed after a global fix. It is never replaced by a new favorable seed.
independentUnits.noPooling: Development episodes select cells and freeze nuisance choices; they are never pooled into confirmation intervals or success counts.

gateOrder.action: An independent reader checks every prior-work equation against the cited version and marks every adaptation; failure stops comparative claims.
Run timestamp lineage checks and forbidden-field scans on utility inputs; any leakage stops the entire run family.
Verify byte conservation, queue conservation, fixed-load calibration, bounds, simultaneous commit semantics and zero-overlap G_offdiag.
Run all development seeds, estimate G and J, select confirmation cells by the label-blind spectral rule, and freeze the manifest.
Run fresh seeds and paired controls without tuning.
Complete half-step, load-matched, feedback-off and queue checks before any semantic interpretation.

developmentAnalysis: Estimate directed G_ij interventions and verify the zero-overlap negative control.
Construct the lifted smooth-surrogate equilibrium, finite-difference Jacobian, spectral envelope, leading eigenmode and load-only comparator for every valid cell.
Use labels only for diagnostic plots and to verify that the chosen grid spans outcomes; labels do not alter operational thresholds or confirmation cell selection.
Freeze load-calibration constants, baseline parameters, utility normalizers, cell IDs and all code hashes before confirmation seed generation.

confirmationAnalysis.cellSummary: Report count/30 and Wilson 95 percent interval for each binary outcome; report median and seed-bootstrap 95 percent interval for amplitude, dominant period, CBR, queue-area, delivered utility and Jain fairness.
confirmationAnalysis.boundaryAccuracy: For valid rho<=0.95 and rho>=1.05 cells, compute balanced accuracy, AUROC and Brier score for rho(J). Compare against mean post-step offered load, mean CBR and the load-only Jacobian using the same held-out cells.
confirmationAnalysis.boundaryLocation: Within each ordered gain or delay sweep that brackets a transition, compare the predicted rho=1 crossing with the empirical 50 percent oscillation crossing; interpolate only between adjacent preregistered grid points.
confirmationAnalysis.starvationPrediction: Compare the frozen equilibrium starved-sender set with confirmation events at sender level, but bootstrap and infer at episode level.

pairedCausalComparisons: full coupling minus load-matched semantic-feedback-off oscillation incidence
full coupling minus zero-overlap oscillation incidence at matched local demand
nominal-step minus half-step classification and continuous metrics
unstabilized minus minimum-service or step-limited starvation and queue burden
analysisPlan.uncertainty: Use seed-level paired bootstrap with 10000 resamples for continuous and incidence differences and Wilson intervals for single-arm proportions. Report effect sizes and intervals; no packet-level p-values are allowed.
analysisPlan.primaryMultiplicity: The three primary families are coupling existence, oscillation boundary prediction and feedback-specific attribution. Apply Holm correction only if null-hypothesis p-values are additionally reported; threshold-based success criteria remain primary.
analysisPlan.missingData: No imputation. A cell with fewer than 30 valid confirmation episodes after global fixes is incomplete and cannot satisfy success criteria.
analysisPlan.indeterminateCells: Cells with undefined Jacobian, failed load matching, F(t)=0 for starvation, or half-step disagreement are shown explicitly and excluded only from the metric they cannot identify; exclusions are never silently dropped.
reporting: Publish all cell manifests, including stable, unstable, indeterminate and failed cells.
Show rate, theta, delta, CBR, queue and m_i trajectories for the same preregistered representative seeds: smallest confirmation seed in each selected cell.
Report both full J and semantic-off J spectra and the leading eigenvector sender support.
Do not convert a stable null envelope into a positive controller-performance claim.

couplingMechanism: The practicalNonzero G criterion holds in balanced-overlap or asymmetric-overlap traces.
The zero-overlap maximum absolute off-diagonal derivative is below 0.005.
At least one leading-mode path contains both a nonzero semantic off-diagonal block and the shared congestion or threshold-period block.
stabilityBoundary: Across held-out valid cells, rho(J) has AUROC>=0.80 and balanced accuracy>=0.75 for persistent oscillation using the frozen 0.95 and 1.05 margins.

Predicted-stable cells have oscillation in at most 6 of 30 episodes and predicted-unstable cells in at least 24 of 30 episodes for at least three of the four nodeCount-by-updateMode strata that contain both labels.
The rho=1 crossing is within one preregistered gain or delay grid step of the empirical 50 percent crossing in at least three strata.
rho(J) improves AUROC by at least 0.10 or Brier score by at least 0.05 over both mean offered load and the load-only Jacobian comparator.
causalAttribution: In at least one matched boundary stratum, full coupling oscillation incidence exceeds load-matched semantic-feedback-off by at least 0.30 and the seed-level paired 95 percent interval excludes zero.
When full coupling has oscillation in at least 24 of 30 episodes, load-matched feedback-off has it in at most 6 of 30 episodes or the semantic claim is rejected.
The effect remains directionally consistent under asynchronous phases and has no hiddenCongestion classification.
halfStep: Nominal and half-step episode classifications agree for at least 27 of 30 paired seeds per decisive cell.
Median oscillation amplitude, dominant period, mean CBR and queue-area differ by at most 5 percent; Jain differs by at most 0.02 absolute.
Any quarter-step adjudication converges toward the half-step result; otherwise the cell is numerical and cannot support a claim.
starvationClaim: A starvation claim is made only in a predicted-stable cell with bounded queue and no oscillation.
The frozen equilibrium predictor reaches episode-level precision>=0.75 and recall>=0.75 for whether any sender starves across the selected asymmetric-overlap confirmation cells.
The same sender has positiveMarginalUtility throughout the five-second interval; low service caused solely by no eligible demand is excluded.
stabilizerClaim: A safeguard reduces starvation or oscillation incidence by at least 0.50 absolute and the paired 95 percent interval excludes zero.

It increases mean CBR by no more than 0.02, queue-area by no more than 10 percent, overflow by zero bytes and delivered visible utility loss by no more than 5 percent relative to the unstabilized arm.
It does not satisfy the criterion merely by pinning all senders at r_min or theta_max.
successCriteria.boundedNull: If all controls and Jacobian checks pass but no valid cell reaches the unstable or starvation definitions, report the largest tested N, gain, delay, period, overlap and load as a stable null envelope; the positive stability-boundary claim is not supported.

killCriteria.condition: Any online utility input uses a future timestamp, analysis-only identity, future packet outcome or perception/safety label.
killCriteria.action: Invalidate all affected run families and stop the semantic claim until the dataflow is rebuilt and rerun from untouched seeds.

killCriteria.condition: No directed pair meets the practical nonzero off-diagonal G criterion in balanced or asymmetric overlap.
killCriteria.action: Kill the cross-sender semantic coupling claim; retain only a load-controller protocol study.

killCriteria.condition: Zero-overlap produces max absolute off-diagonal G>=0.005.
killCriteria.action: Stop for association, random-stream or state-leakage contamination.

killCriteria.condition: Persistent oscillation or starvation remains unchanged under semantic-feedback-off at successfully matched load.
killCriteria.action: Attribute the effect to load-only, scheduler or numeric dynamics and kill the semantic-specific claim.

killCriteria.condition: Confirmation load matching exceeds any declared tolerance in the decisive cell.
killCriteria.action: Mark the cell nonIdentifying; no post hoc offset or capacity retuning is allowed.

killCriteria.condition: Nominal and half-step classifications agree in fewer than 27 of 30 seeds, or quarter-step does not converge toward half-step.
killCriteria.action: Kill claims from that boundary as a discretization artifact.

killCriteria.condition: More than 10 percent of Jacobian columns fail perturbation convergence, or all candidate boundary cells are clip-dominated and have no valid spectral envelope.
killCriteria.action: Do not make a local spectral-boundary claim; report the hard-model outcome as descriptive only.

killCriteria.condition: rho(J) fails both AUROC and balanced-accuracy thresholds or does not beat load-only comparators by the preregistered margin.
killCriteria.action: Kill the predictive-boundary claim even if selected trajectories look oscillatory.

killCriteria.condition: A proposed stabilizer lowers CBR while increasing queue-area above 10 percent, creates overflow, or suppresses delivered visible utility by more than 5 percent.
killCriteria.action: Classify it as congestion displacement or service suppression, not stabilization.

killCriteria.condition: A result requires treating senders, packets, objects or time steps as independent samples.
The QoQ, LIMERIC or FABRIC baseline equations fail independent transcription or their own sanity equilibrium checks.
killCriteria.action: Stop comparative claims involving that baseline; never substitute an undocumented approximation under the same name.

killCriteria.condition: A confirmation constant, utility normalizer, cell choice or operational threshold is changed after any confirmation outcome is viewed.
killCriteria.action: Treat all later runs as exploratory and issue a new versioned preregistration before confirmation restarts.

knownLimitations: The primary model is a deliberately small single-collision-domain abstraction with fluid service; it cannot reproduce CSMA contention, hidden terminals, capture, fading or real radio scheduling.

The smooth surrogate is not the hard event model. Its Jacobian is a local diagnostic whose validity must be earned out of sample and may fail near threshold, clip, queue-empty or packet-completion discontinuities.
The Artery-derived local utility terms are protocol metadata proxies, not measured receiver perception gain. Multiplying them by a visible redundancy proxy does not make them neural-task utility.
Payload-visible association can be wrong because CPM object IDs are sender-scoped and pseudonym changes break continuity; oracle identities are intentionally withheld online.

QoQ v1 uses abstract channel scaling and synthetic VoI distributions, has no verified paper-specific code in the audited materials and fixes CPM generation at 100 ms; this protocol's adaptive period is a new experimental model.
LIMERIC's alpha+K*beta<2 condition applies to its normalized load-only linear model and is not sufficient for this delayed nonlinear hybrid system.
FABRIC's convergence guarantee concerns its NUM assumptions and sufficiently small step; a trace-driven utility and finite queue can violate those assumptions.
Artery commit e0ddd8c was source-inspected but not compiled in the audited host, so no result may be described as an Artery reproduction until that separate gate is completed.
Equal-share starvation and Jain thresholds are operational choices. Heterogeneous utility-aware allocation is therefore reported separately and not forced into an equal-rate fairness claim.
The 60-second horizon can miss slower modes. A mode with predicted period above 10 seconds is marked horizon-limited rather than stable.
The protocol cannot support C-V2X, real perception-quality or road-safety claims without separate transport and perception-trace validation.

prohibitedShortcuts: No future-label or full-trace normalization in online utility.
No oracle global object identity for cross-sender matching.
No tuning on confirmation outcomes or replacing failed seeds.
No packet, object, sender or time-step pseudoreplication.
No controller-specific capacity calibration after the common stratum constant is frozen.
No silent queue reset, packet deletion or clipping without a logged drop event.
No calling an approximate baseline QoQ, LIMERIC, FABRIC or Artery unless its stated equation and execution gate is met.
No aggregate CBR plot without offered-load, carried-load and queue traces.
implementationContract.preExecutionAcceptance: Before any confirmation run, an independent reviewer must verify equation provenance, the observability dataflow, seed disjointness, label-blind cell selection and load-calibration freeze. This is a protocol acceptance gate, not a candidate score.
